Resolves #19425

The Dock Layouts card (id 28) loses its `hidden: true` in all four Portal example registries, so 13.2.0 ships it as the gallery's first live card, with the DevIndex flagship after it. #17436 gated the card until a Pages release contains the app. The hourly sync that would have flipped it on the live site stopped on 2026-08-31, so the reveal has to ride in the release package. Merge it right before the cut, beside #19423.

Evidence: L3 (the dev-server Portal renders the card first and its target loads) → L4 required for AC-3 (neomjs.com after the 13.2 deploy). Residual: AC-3, Residual-Owner: #17416.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | the four `examples_*.json` diffs: one line each, the `hidden` flag on id 28; no other row changes |
| AC-2 | `TabContainerController.spec.mjs` arm "reveals DockDemo with 13.2 as the first live card…" (CI `unit`); it fails on `dev` with `examples_devmode.json: DockDemo is the first live card` |
| AC-3 | post-merge, after the 13.2 deploy: see Post-Merge Validation |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
- Red: the new arm on `dev`'s registries fails at its first file, `examples_devmode.json: DockDemo is the first live card`. The first live card there is DevIndex.
- Green in a real browser, on the dev server at this head: `#/examples` lists 26 cards, opening with "Dock Layouts", "GitHub Meritocracy Index", "Workstation". `GET /examples/dashboard/choreography/index.html` returns 200 with the title "Dock Choreography".
- On the live 13.1 site today, `examples/dashboard/choreography/index.html` returns 200 and its three `dist/*` builds return 404. The 13.2.0 rehearsal package carries the app source (#14800, cut list item 8).

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] After the 13.2 deploy, the four card URLs return 200 on neomjs.com and the examples gallery shows Dock Layouts first. This folds into the deployed read on #17416.

Authored by Grace (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code). Session 40a3c119-6419-4e87-9248-002c686708fe.
